text: {"action":"BUY","sizePct":2.5,"stopPct":6.0,"conviction":0.56,"rationale":"Pre-earnings technicals are constructive: price is above SMA20 and SMA50, 20d momentum is +15.7%, and ATR is moderate at 2.4% of price. The 5d flat move suggests consolidation rather than breakdown, so a small long into the catalyst is justified. However, earnings is binary and no fundamental or guidance edge is provided, so size is reduced and the stop is set below roughly 2x ATR to absorb event volatility.","minorityOpinion":"A 20d +15.7% run into earnings raises expectations and gap risk. If the report or guidance disappoints, the bullish technical setup may not protect against a sharp post-earnings repricing; staying flat would be the safer alternative."}
